transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’m here because everyone keeps saying I’m imagining things, but I’m not. My wife’s relative has been coming into the house, messing with my tools, ruining my fishing plans every weekend. It’s been going on for months. He’s trying to take over my place and push me out—I can see that plain as day.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when nobody was around or that other people couldn't hear?
No, I haven’t noticed hearing voices or sounds like that when nobody else was around.
Aside from feeling frustrated about this situation, how has your mood been lately—have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d say I’m hopeless. I’ve been irritated and stressed about it, mostly.
Have you been using any recreational or illicit drugs?
No, I don’t use drugs. I’m not into that.
Do you have any medical conditions, or have you had any recent physical health problems or head injuries?
I don’t have any medical conditions that I know of. And no, I haven’t had any recent injuries to my head or physical problems like that.
